authentication_model.rationale: A native APK cannot safely retain a reusable backend secret. Authorization to an entitlement is therefore never inferred from possession of a client credential; the backend validates the unguessable Play purchase token against Google and the exact package/product contract.

timeout_budget.policy: server Google-I/O budget must remain below the mobile verification timeout; timeout/failure never grants a new entitlement

abuse_and_data_minimization.play_integrity_note: Not required by the current launch contract; reconsider if abuse telemetry shows public verification endpoint quota/cost pressure. Do not add an attestation SDK silently because it changes privacy/Data Safety scope.

release_requirements: deploy the exact reviewed container revision without embedding service-account keys
attach a dedicated service account and grant only the Google Play/Firestore permissions needed by this service
enable Google Play Android Developer API and authorize the service identity for the application
create/configure Firestore and prove transactional token-to-product binding under concurrent requests
freeze a public HTTPS endpoint and production abuse/rate-limit controls
freeze purchase-record retention/deletion with 12.3 privacy policy and Data Safety
preserve the bounded server/mobile timeout budget under the production ingress configuration
run unit tests and static backend gate on the exact deployment commit
exercise PURCHASED, PENDING, cancelled, restored, refunded/revoked, duplicate and concurrent acknowledgement cases against Play test tracks
persist deployment revision, endpoint, service identity fingerprint/non-secret identifier and evidence without committing credentials
